source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware by Redfish when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade GPUBB firmware through redfish
1. Check GPU can be detected correct after load GPU driver
2. Upload firmware file to SUT BMC
Command : sshpass -p 0penBmc scp nvfw_HGX-H100x8_0002_240312.1.0_prod-signed.fwpkg root@10.36.50.10:/var/tmp
3. Using POST command to start the flash progress
Command : curl ${bmc}/redfish/v1/UpdateService -T nvfw_HGX-H100x8_0002_240312.1.0_prod-signed.fwpkg -X POST (Noted : bmc=HMC ip)
4. Check firmware flash progress
Command : curl -k -H "X-Auth-Token: $token" -X GET http://192.168.31.1/redfish/v1/TaskService/Tasks/0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: curl (Redfish REST client, on the BMC side) + GPUBB image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- GPUBB downgrade via Redfish (system is off): the agent needs the exact user-provided GPUBB image first the host must be powered OFF first (flash while system is off), then runs the Redfish update flow: `PATCH /redfish/v1/UpdateService` (set preserve/replace behavior), `POST /redfish/v1/UpdateService` to upload the image, poll the returned TaskService task to completion, then `GET /redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory` to confirm the new version is active. Not a single one-liner; run step-by-step after the image is placed on the BMC.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the full Redfish PATCH/POST response, the TaskService poll loop, and the final `FirmwareInventory` JSON so the user confirms the GPUBB version changed and the SUT powers on cleanly after the off-state flash.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: GPUBB firmware flash via Redfish is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; flash only the user-specified image with host powered off for a clean result, and never interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade GPUBB firmware through a Redfish path with the host off, then power on and prove the GPUBB task, active firmware and GPU topology/health belong to the same SUT.
original_method: Check GPUs, SCP an H100x8 package to fixed SUT-BMC 10.36.50.10, POST to `${bmc}` labeled HMC, and poll fixed HTTP Task 0 at 192.168.31.1.
manual_activity: Platform/RD must identify the authoritative update controller and endpoint relationship; an engineer approves the corrected destructive off-state plan and recovery.
required_inputs: GPUBB board/GPU platform/package versions and hashes
Secure credentials/TLS, GPU criteria and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Do not execute plaintext `sshpass`, fixed IPs, HTTP Task 0 or `curl -k`.
Do not accept a task from an endpoint not cryptographically and transactionally tied to the update request.
Validate H100x8 package against exact GPUBB/GPU platform.
Never retry, reverse or power-cycle an uncertain update; preserve GPU, task, BMC/SEL and console evidence.
agent_execution_scope: After topology correction, discover the vendor action, transfer one verified package through the authoritative controller, poll only the returned task and collect post-power-on GPUBB/GPU/BMC/host evidence.
Do not upload while endpoint/task identity is unresolved and do not issue the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve SUT-BMC/HMC/task ownership and define off-state activation/power-on sequence.
Approve package, GPU acceptance/security/recovery and final verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its generic UpdateService flow is not the source SCP/HMC/task path and cannot reconcile three endpoints. Missing package alone would not block, but task/target identity does.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No source write is authorized. After correction, use trusted TLS/protected secrets, a vendor GPUBB action and the task URI returned by that exact request.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The H100x8 package, fixed SCP address, HMC note, fixed task URL, host-off intent, GPU script and 10/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Document controller topology, bind the signed package to the exact GPUBB, submit via the advertised action, monitor the response-correlated task, execute approved power-on and compare GPUBB inventory plus GPU UUID/topology/driver/XID/kernel health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only the verified GPUBB/HGX platform and its authoritative BMC or HMC service.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor GPUBB/HGX update, task, activation and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates plaintext/fixed routing and Task 0 assumptions; adds transaction correlation and GPU evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves the right offline SUT update and catches GPU initialization regression after power-on.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner endpoint topology and vendor contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A task on a different endpoint may be valid but unrelated; network reachability is not correlation.

project_override_considerations: Addresses may be project-specific, but an override must document how staging, update and task endpoints belong to one SUT and transaction; it cannot merely replace literals.
expected_evidence: Redacted transfer/update response and returned task transcript
Pre/post GPUBB and GPU UUID/topology/diagnostic evidence plus BMC/SEL health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source stages on 10.36.50.10, POSTs to a variable labeled HMC, and polls fixed HTTP Task 0 on 192.168.31.1 without linking them. It cannot prove the observed task belongs to the written offline SUT.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Controller and task identity are essential destructive semantics, not ordinary address parameters. Execution could update one target and validate another, so correction is required.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects its substituted generic path and preserves only later API potential.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on BLOCKED, focusing the reason on endpoint/task identity rather than missing versions.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps package and GPU criteria as readiness inputs while reserving BLOCKED for uncorrelated destructive routing.

review_improvement: Requires end-to-end transaction identity across staging, update and task monitoring and GPU-specific post-power-on validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: An automated task poll is meaningless if it may be on another controller. Until BMC/HMC topology and response correlation are defined, the off-state write and its evidence cannot safely be associated with one SUT.
